rounds.text: The fundamental growth story of Enkei Wheels India Ltd is significantly outpacing its recent stock price performance, with 5-year compounded profit growth at 18% [E19] and 3-year profit growth at 35% [E20], contrasting against a 5-year share price return of -1% [E23] and a 1-year return of -29% [E25]. This creates a classic fundamentals-led divergence where profit growth exceeds 1-year price growth by 247%, signaling that the business is starting to outperform expectations while sentiment remains stale [E56, E74]. Operational momentum is clear with trailing twelve-month sales growth at 23% [E17], quarterly sales up 31% YoY [E64], and quarterly net profit up 88% YoY [E66]. Furthermore, the company operates within an Automobile and Auto Components sector experiencing a confirmed macro tailwind with a score of +0.53 [E73, E75].
